description:
BAU Global, Turkey's world brand in education, with nine universities and three language schools in 10 countries on three continents, offers its students the experience of genuinely international students.

Bahçeşehir University, whose main campus is in Besiktas, Istanbul, offers educational opportunities to its students on campuses worldwide within the scope of Bahcesehir Global. BAU Global, which is a first in Turkey and one of the leading brands in the world, with the globalization steps taken since the day it was founded, educates its students as global citizens with the universities, language schools, and communication centers opened in many different countries of the world.

BAU Global, which started its education life in Istanbul in 1998, accelerated its investments abroad after Bahcesehir University. He opened universities in Batumi that gave diplomas according to the laws of Georgia and carried his education network to the international arena. Cyprus Bahcesehir University, one of the essential education networks of BAU Global, started to provide education to students in the 2017-2018 academic year.

In these universities that are members of the BAU Global education network; Many English language courses, including undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral level academic programs, language courses, architectural design, communication, economics, administrative and social sciences, educational sciences, engineering, and natural sciences, health sciences, law, medicine, applied sciences and dentistry While there are undergraduate, graduate and doctoral programs, it also provides its students with the opportunity to become 'world citizens.’

In addition to universities opened abroad, BAU Global's preparatory training in Toronto and Washington DC; At Berlin International University, students can spend any part of their education they wish. They can attend summer schools and visit many different centers to improve themselves professionally. In addition, with Mentora Language Schools in Washington DC, Mentora Berlin in Germany, and CES Toronto language schools in Canada, language education is given to students from both Turkey and many other countries of the world.
